label: Sticker / Prop
description: The personality layer: a physical prop that sits ON other content. kind 'stamp' (rotated rubber-stamp slam, e.g. SAVE / SHIPPED), 'gesture' (a small instruction like 'Swipe up to save' -- pair with an arrow in the text), 'pill' (solid label chip, e.g. STONKS), 'ring' (a drawn circle highlighting a spot), 'logo' (the company's WORDMARK in white on a brand-colour pill, popped in as the line says the name -- the image comes from the brand kit automatically; text is the name, used if no logo exists), 'url' (the link as a GLASSY PILL with an arrow that a cursor comes to and clicks -- the launch-film close; text is the address), 'image' (a DIE-CUT STICKER dropping in as a physical object with a settle, optional slow swing, and comic whoosh accents -- the moment-augmenting sticker: a stack of cash on 'money', a chimp on 'MailChimp' (never a brand's logo)). Name it with `sticker` from the HOUSE STICKER LIBRARY: money-stack, dollar-bill, coin, money-bag, credit-card, chimp, dinosaur, floppy-disk, fax-machine, snail, rocket, fire, lightning-bolt, clock, hourglass, calendar, coffee-cup, laptop, envelope, inbox-tray, megaphone, lightbulb, target, magnifying-glass, chart-up, chart-down, spreadsheet, trophy, crown, medal, star, sparkles, heart, thumbs-up, thumbs-down, check-mark, cross-mark, warning-sign, party-popper, brain, robot, mind-blown, sleeping-face, handshake. A name the library lacks is drawn in the house style on first use (say what to draw in `sticker_subject`); `src` takes any other transparent image. Position and size it with the component's position box. Seasoning, never the subject: 1-3 per scene max (an image prop may be the scene's visual anchor beside a headline).

kind.label: stamp | gesture | pill | ring | image | url | logo

text.label: The prop's text (not used for ring/image); for url, the address (e.g. getquotient.ai)

sticker.label: image: a house-library sticker by name (money-stack, chimp, rocket, clock ...) -- or a new name, drawn in the house style on first use. Sets kind 'image' and the src for you.

sticker_subject.label: image: what to draw when the sticker name is new to the library (e.g. 'a cheerful cartoon chimpanzee face')

src.label: image only: a transparent image URL (a REAL /assets/... path) when the sticker is not a library name -- prefer `sticker`. NEVER invent a src. logo: optional -- the brand kit's wordmark is filled in when empty.

motion.label: image only: 'settle' (default) | 'swing' (slow residual sway, a hung object)

whoosh.label: image only: comic motion accents near the entry corner (default true)

color.label: Prop color (defaults: stamp/gesture amber, pill primary, ring green)

scale.label: Size multiplier for the whole prop (a tall speaker frame sets 1.8 so fixed-pixel type reads on a phone)

cursor.label: url only: a cursor arrives and clicks the pill (default true)

click_at.label: url only: when the click lands (scene seconds; default 1.3s after the pill)

ink.label: url only: white (default, for a color/photo/sky ground) | dark (near-black text on a light ground)
